reuse.why: Extends the existing shared weekend helpers (getDateWithSkippedWeekend, isDroppedWeekendOccurrence, the search-limit constant) rather than adding parallel holiday logic at the call sites.

duplication.why: Holiday membership is decided once in isWeekendOrHoliday, but the holidays argument has to be threaded through four copies of the pre-existing 'skipWeekend && !skipsWeekendOccurrences ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...)' ternary, which the diff extends rather than consolidates.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts with the other weekend logic; server callers only pass the config field, and the type and rule-utils mapping are updated where the config is defined and parsed.

scope.why: Only the weekend helpers, their callers, the RecurConfig type and tests are changed.

maintainability.why: Clear single predicate and generalised stepping loop; the search window bounds (getWeekendSkipSearchLimit vs getDatesInRangeSearchPadding) are two separate heuristics and every caller must remember to pass holidays explicitly.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts isWeekendOrHoliday, used by both getDateWithSkippedWeekend and isDroppedWeekendOccurrence; call sites in schedules/app.ts, schedule-template.ts and getNextDate only pass config.holidays
